blocks.x: Agentic AI & Hyperautomation for Care Management & Population Health — digital workers, decision hubs and self-healing workflows — governed autonomy at enterprise scale applied to the care management & population health operating unit of Healthcare & Life Sciences.

Care management succeeds on precision targeting and timely intervention: identifying rising-risk members, coordinating across providers, and proving quality outcomes. It is a data-discipline business — and the data discipline is usually the missing part.

items: Care outreach, scheduling and follow-up run on call lists; gaps between contacts lose members.
Claims, clinical, SDOH and engagement data siloed; risk stratification runs on claims only.

blocks.x: The pattern composes Process & Task Mining, Process & Task Mining, Autonomous Workflow Orchestration from the Agentic AI & Hyperautomation tower, wired into the unit's workflows (Risk stratification, Care outreach and scheduling, Program matching) on Achala Swarm and Achala Nexus and Achala Compass. Governance inherits the sector frame — HIPAA among others — with evidence generated by the delivery itself.

items: See the work as it actually runs — event-log truth before you automate anything.
One automation spine — APIs, events, RPA and agents composable under common control.
Self-healing workflows — long-running business processes that adapt, retry and recover without tickets.
contact plans executed across channels with follow-up policy (completion up 25-40%)
